value.rationale: The recently established Ky Fan concentration inequality makes spectral response to fixed-area mask geometry a natural question. The finding determines every optimal Hermite-mode subspace at every annular hole radius and spectral rank, characterizes each otherwise discontinuous optimizer switch by an exact unique equation and a strictly positive Ky Fan kink, and quantifies large-area instability by an explicit exponentially small hole scale. This is a meaningful complete structural classification and dual asymptotic laws, beyond the known special rank-one threshold or routine unsorted-moment computation.
